## Quarto

Linear regression models for clinical biomarkers, systolic and diastolic blood pressure, ventricular rate.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(mgcv)

```

```{r}
#Linear mixed model for lab measurements
#filter for creatinine < 2000
labs <- df_creatinine %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EVENT_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED < 2000)

```

```{r}
#log-transform
labs$log_val <- log(labs$MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED)

```

Linear regression models

```{r}
lin <- lm(log_val ~ allele + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)
confint(lin)

#plot
ggplot(labs_first, aes(x = EVENT_AGE, y = MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED, color = allele)) + 
  geom_smooth() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  ggtitle("First creatinine measure")
```

Blood pressure models

```{r}
labs <- df_bp_first %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EVENT_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10))

hist(labs$SYSTOLIC_BP)
hist(labs$SYSTOLIC_BP[labs$SYSTOLIC_BP > 6])
plot(SYSTOLIC_BP ~ allele, data=labs)
```

```{r}
#linear model
lin <- lm(SYSTOLIC_BP ~allele2 + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)

lin <- lm(DIASTOLIC_BP ~allele + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)

lin <- lm(DIASTOLIC_BP ~allele2 + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)
coef(lin)
confint(lin)


ggplot(result, aes(x = EVENT_AGE, y = SYSTOLIC_BP, color = allele)) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  ggtitle("First BP measure")
```

(NT-proBNP) Natriuretic peptide, B type N-terminal propeptide

```{r}
#filter 
labs <- df_probnp %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EVENT_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED > 0.0001) %>%
  dplyr::filter(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED <250000)

#log-transform
labs$log_val <- log(labs$MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED)
```

```{r}
#QC
hist(labs$MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED[labs$MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED > 50000])
hist(labs$log_val)
hist(labs_first$log_val[labs_first$log_val > 6])
plot(log_val ~ allele, data=labs_first)
```

```{r}
lin <- lm(log_val ~allele2 + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)
confint(lin)
exp(coef(lin))

#plot
ggplot(labs_first, aes(x = EVENT_AGE, y = log_val, color = allele)) + 
  geom_smooth() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  ggtitle("First pBNP measure")
```

```{r}
#filter 
labs <- df_uacr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EVENT_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED < 6000) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED = if_else(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED == 0, 0.0001, MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED))


#log-transform
labs$log_val <- log(labs$MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED)
```

```{r}
lin <- lm(log_val ~allele2 + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)
confint(lin)
```

```{r}
#filter 
labs <- df_hemac %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EVENT_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10, COUNT)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED < 100) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED = ifelse( MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED < 1, MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED * 100, MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED))

```

```{r}
lin <- lm(MEASUREMENT_VALUE_HARMONIZED ~allele2 + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)
confint(lin)
```

TG/HDL ratio as insulin resistance surrogate marker

```{r}
labs <- df_ratio %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FINNGENID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(EVENT_AGE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10))

hist(labs$TG_HDL_ratio)
hist(labs$TG_HDL_ratio[labs$TG_HDL_ratio > 50])
plot(TG_HDL_ratio ~ allele, data=labs)

labs$log_val <- log(labs$TG_HDL_ratio)
plot(log_val ~ allele, data=labs)
```

```{r}
lin <- lm(log_val ~allele2 + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)
summary(lin)
confint(lin)

lin <- lm(log_val ~allele + SEX + EVENT_AGE, data = labs)

```
